pillars.target: 20%+ annual NOV growth, invest over margin

parameters.name: Unique capability
parameters.evidence: Only Indian platform at national scale across food + dark-store grid + restaurant supply: B2C NOV ₹35,644 Cr/qtr, 28M monthly customers (Q2 FY27)

parameters.name: Copy resistance
parameters.evidence: Grid took ~4 years and thousands of crores — but Swiggy Instamart/Zepto match city-by-city; consumer switching cost ~zero

parameters.name: Quality over quantity
parameters.evidence: Adj EBITDA +197% to ₹666 Cr vs NOV +54%; Blinkit margin up 6 straight quarters to 0.9% of NOV

parameters.name: Volume discipline
parameters.evidence: Growth chosen over margin: food adj EBITDA margin slipped to 5.5% of NOV; store target raised twice (3,000→3,500→5,000)

parameters.name: Customer satisfaction/retention
parameters.evidence: No churn/NPS/renewal metric disclosed; only proxies — MTC 28M (+16%), 5 quarters of accelerating order growth

parameters.name: R&D investment
parameters.evidence: No R&D line disclosed; product proof: Dark AI launch, District app, ads platform

parameters.name: Free cash flow
parameters.evidence: CFO +₹632 Cr FY26 but capex ~₹1,746 Cr → FCF −₹1,114 Cr, second negative year; funded by treasury

parameters.name: Debt management
parameters.evidence: Cash & investments ₹16,475 Cr vs borrowings ₹5,757 Cr (incl. leases); net cash ~₹10,718 Cr; no dilution

parameters.name: Management stability
parameters.evidence: Founder-CEO Goyal stepped down Feb-2026 after 18 years (vice-chairman now); Blinkit co-founder Dhindsa promoted from within; CFO continues

parameters.name: Capital allocation
parameters.evidence: Treasury earns ₹1,416 Cr/yr, but ROE 0.4% and ROCE 2.5% sit far below cost of capital

valuation.methodology: FCFE DCF (5yr, 10.3% discount, 0% terminal) + multiples-based intrinsic; buy zone = 20% MOS

anchor.guidance: B2C NOV 60% CAGR over 3 yrs; Blinkit 3,500 stores by Mar-27; food delivery 20%+

takeaway: India's fastest-scaling consumer platform with a ₹16,475 Cr treasury behind it — but the 'profit' is interest income, and ₹317 is a 621× bet that growth arrives before the multiple does.
